system.description:
¿Por qué no los dos? —Mia Agraviador, Old El Paso Taco Commercial Spellblades, gishes, arcane knights, and eldritch tricksters all. Magi are arcane specialists that blend magic and martial prowess.

The magus may be a bit more challenging for newer players. Their playstyle is more builddependent than the other classes, allowing for backline blasters, midline harassers, and frontline strikers.

  • Action: Attack/Cast
  • Move: Flexible
  • Key Stat: Reason
  • Complexity: HHHHI
  • Training: Arcana, Melee

Trainings at Level 1: the Class's Trainings, plus a number of additional Trainings equal to half your Reason (round up).

features.name: Arcanum
features.description:
You gain the Gish Perk (p. 69) and can Cast Spells using Arcana.

Spells: You learn 2 Spells, one of which must always have a damage base. You learn 1 other Spell every 3 Levels hereafter.

Mana: Your Max Mana is equal to (2 × your Level), and your Cast Max for Spells is equal to (1 + half your Level, round up).

features.name: Enspell
features.description: You can have one Imbue Casting as continual duration on your Weapon, and can skip your Move to change the Spell.

features.name: Spell Parry
features.description:
If the result of your Save against a Cast Action exceeds your Difficulty by 15, you can choose a different Target for it, ignoring Immunity. The number needed to exceed is reduced by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

Magus: 2nd, 6th, 10th Level.

features.name: Arcane Surge
features.description:
It costs 1 less Mana to Cast your Imbued Spell with other Deliveries.

Further, once per Round when you deliver a Spell with an Imbued Weapon, you can do so against one Target with a 1 Mana discount. This discount increases every 4 Levels hereafter.

Magus: 4th, 8th Level.

features.name: Esoteric Flow
features.description: You can cause the damage of your attack to use the damage base of your Imbued Spell. Further, you are permanently under the effects of the Blink Spell.

features.name: Sword & Sorcery
features.description: Once per Round, when you take the Attack Action, you can also take the Cast Action, and vice versa.
